verdict.rationale: Ramp's MCP and CLI explicitly support conversational receipt-chasing ('Find transactions with missing receipts... draft reminder messages'), policy Q&A, and pre-spend policy checks ('See policy status for every option... before trips get rejected'; recommended actions 'grounded in your policies, budgets, and funds'). The CLI even ships dedicated 'explain-missing' and 'flag-missing' subcommands and MCP scopes are live-verified via probe. Missing for 10: a concrete hands-on transcript of an assistant answering 'can I expense this?' pre-purchase, and independent (non-vendor) corroboration of these conversational flows in practice.
